_README: Prompt matchers used by fingerprint.py to log in to a console BEFORE the
vendor is known. Each family is a list of Python regexes; a device line is
considered a match if ANY regex in the family matches. Anchor with \s*$ so
the pattern matches only at the END of the current line (the live prompt).
Add a newly-observed prompt string here (no code change needed) and restart
the console agent. If this file is missing or invalid, fingerprint.py falls
back to its built-in defaults. Override the path with $CONSOLE_PROMPT_PATTERNS.
When a device shows output but matches NONE of these, identification can't log
in and escalates to the LLM identify path (which reads the raw capture to work
out what the prompt is) — so adding the string here fixes it permanently.
The 'hostname_prompt' family is different: each regex MUST capture the
device hostname in group 1 (it is read to name the port), and the first
pattern that matches wins — list the most specific shapes first.
